newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN INTERBREW SIGNS TWO DEALS IN JAPAN.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN INTERBREW SIGNS TWO DEALS IN JAPAN.

text.p: Belgian brewery group Interbrew said on Monday it signed two distribution agreements in Japan.

It said in a statement it signed the first deal with Asahi Brewery Ltd, one of Japan's largest breweries, for the distribution of Belle-Vue Kriek beer. A second deal was clinched with Konishi Brewing Co. Ltd. for the distribution of the Hoegaarden range of beers.

Privately-held Interbrew, one of the world's leading brewing groups in terms of volume, noted there was a strong growth in interest for speciality beers in Japan, which is traditionally a lager beer market.

Interbrew said Bell-Vue Kriek would initially be marketed in the Tokyo metropolitan area and reach national distribution by the end of this year. Distribution of Hoegaarden beers will be targeted nation-wide.
